name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_update
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::Update writes text, moves the cursor to the end, updates label text, and invalidates.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4b4e60 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4b4e60 validates SetContents, cursor set to strlen(text), GetBuffer, optional first label panel SetText, and self invalidation.
The native smoke verifies Update("123") writes the text, cursor 3, propagates the label-panel text pointer, and invalidates.
